Class Qwen

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.model.qwen.Qwen
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, ModelExecutor, LanguageModel
public class Qwen extends Object implements LanguageModel, AutoCloseable, ModelExecutor
Qwen3.5 hybrid text model (Gated DeltaNet + gated full attention).

    • build

      public static Qwen build(String checkpointDir, int maxBatchSize, int maxSeqLen, byte deviceId, double memFractionStatic, String kvCacheDtype, int pageSize, ParallelConfig parallel, int modelLoaderThreads) throws IOException
      Builds a Qwen instance with optional tensor parallelism, KV page size, and safetensors loader concurrency.
      Parameters:
      checkpointDir - directory containing config.json and weights.
      maxBatchSize - maximum batch size for inference.
      maxSeqLen - maximum sequence length; <= 0 uses the config value.
      deviceId - CUDA device id, or negative for CPU.
      memFractionStatic - static-region fraction of total GPU memory (SGLang-style); <=0 keeps test sizing.
      kvCacheDtype - optional KV dtype override.
      pageSize - tokens per radix / KV pool page (>= 1).
      parallel - ParallelConfig.tensorParallel(byte...) for multi-GPU; ppSize must be 1.
      modelLoaderThreads - safetensors loader threads; 0 = auto (SafeTensorsLoaderThreads.resolve(int, int)).
      Returns:
      a loaded Qwen model.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the checkpoint cannot be read.

    • build

      public static Qwen build(String checkpointDir, int maxBatchSize, int maxSeqLen, byte deviceId, double memFractionStatic, String kvCacheDtype, int pageSize, ParallelConfig parallel, int modelLoaderThreads, int speculativeRows, int speculativeDepth) throws IOException
      Like the overload above, additionally reserving DeltaNet checkpoint memory for batched MTP speculation before the KV pool is sized, so the KV budget accounts for it and a large speculating cohort never has to fall back to plain decode for lack of memory.
      Parameters:
      checkpointDir - directory containing config.json and weights.
      maxBatchSize - maximum batch size for inference.
      maxSeqLen - maximum sequence length; <= 0 uses the config value.
      deviceId - CUDA device id, or negative for CPU.
      memFractionStatic - static-region fraction of total GPU memory (SGLang-style); <=0 keeps test sizing.
      kvCacheDtype - optional KV dtype override.
      pageSize - tokens per radix / KV pool page (>= 1).
      parallel - ParallelConfig.tensorParallel(byte...) for multi-GPU; ppSize must be 1.
      modelLoaderThreads - safetensors loader threads; 0 = auto (SafeTensorsLoaderThreads.resolve(int, int)).
      speculativeRows - rows (concurrently speculating requests) to provision; 0 reserves nothing.
      speculativeDepth - draft depth to provision for; <= 0 uses the model default.
      Returns:
      a loaded Qwen model.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the checkpoint cannot be read.

      public ChatCompletion generate(int[] prompt, int maxGenLen, double temperature, double topp, boolean logprobs, long seed, GenerationListener listener, BooleanSupplier cancelRequested)
      Description copied from interface: LanguageModel
      Generates a completion from an already-tokenized prompt.
      Specified by:
      generate in interface LanguageModel
      Parameters:
      prompt - prompt token id sequence.
      maxGenLen - maximum number of new tokens to generate (not including the prompt itself).
      temperature - sampling temperature; higher values increase randomness.
      topp - nucleus-sampling top-p threshold in (0, 1].
      logprobs - true to include per-token log-probabilities in the result.
      seed - optional RNG seed for deterministic sampling; 0 means non-deterministic.
      listener - optional progress callback; may be null.
      cancelRequested - when non-null and returns true, generation stops between decode steps with CancellationException.
      Returns:
      the completion for prompt.

    • warmPrefix

      public void warmPrefix(int requestId, int[] prompt, int prefixLen)
      Phase-1 hybrid prefix hit: run a full hybrid forward over prompt[0, prefixLen) so DeltaNet recurrent/conv state matches a cold prefill. Shared radix KV pages are rewritten with equivalent values.

      Skipping full-attention residuals here would be incorrect — DeltaNet inputs depend on the residual stream after attention blocks.

      Specified by:
      warmPrefix in interface ModelExecutor
      Parameters:
      requestId - request id from ModelExecutor.bind(int[], int).
      prompt - full prompt tokens.
      prefixLen - page-aligned matched prefix (>= 0).

    • speculateStep

      public int[][] speculateStep(int[] requestIds, int[] lastTokens, int[] positions, int numDrafts, double[] temperatures, double[] topps)
      Description copied from interface: ModelExecutor
      Same as ModelExecutor.speculateStep(int[], int[], int[], int, double, double) with per-request sampling parameters, so a cohort whose requests sample differently is still verified in one batched forward. The default delegates to the scalar overload when every request shares the same parameters and otherwise runs the requests one at a time.
      Specified by:
      speculateStep in interface ModelExecutor
      Parameters:
      requestIds - active KV request ids (order = batch).
      lastTokens - last committed token per request.
      positions - absolute position of lastTokens[i] (write of next is +1).
      numDrafts - draft depth (same for every request in this call).
      temperatures - per-request sampling temperature (verify).
      topps - per-request nucleus top-p (verify).
      Returns:
      accepted token ids per request (each length >= 1; caller owns arrays).
